[operator-attested] Completion-close evidence map for merged SHA 43e822a83fc866f184073fbf08edcb6dd649dbf2 (all nine ACs are checked):

1/4 same-pass preview + exact drift + single active-ticket load: tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/orchestrate/test_bridge_preview_one_pass_heldout.py::test_preview_manifest_carries_exact_same_pass_field_drift.
2 lock-free preview and collateral integrity: tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/orchestrate/test_bridge_canonical_manifest.py::test_preview_bypasses_advisory_lock_and_forwards_existing_route plus tests/interfaces/store/test_bridge_preview_under_sync_contention_heldout.py::test_preview_is_complete_while_sync_locks_are_held.
3 reconcile-check compatibility remains pinned by the existing reconcile-check suite; production code retains reconcile_check.py and _compare_pair unchanged.
5 strict parser + documented legacy spelling: test_real_engine_rejects_abbreviation_before_store_access, test_prefix_abbreviations_are_invocation_errors, and test_documented_legacy_dry_run_spelling_remains_valid.
6 canonical preview/sync manifest + exact tally: test_canonical_uncapped_sync_retains_field_comparable_manifest, test_canonical_sync_manifest_reports_batch_failures_exactly, and test_canonical_sync_tally_excludes_suppressed_inbound_mutations.
7 legacy CLI/library/MCP/live continuity: test_legacy_uncapped_live_keeps_tally_and_removes_manifest, test_library_live_reconcile_keeps_legacy_mode_adapter, and test_mcp_live_reconcile_keeps_legacy_library_call.
8 capped canonical + bootstrap continuity: test_capped_canonical_sync_reports_plan_tally_and_deferred, test_canonical_sync_tally_degrades_safely_when_batch_manifest_is_unreadable, and test_legacy_bootstrap_route_keeps_asymmetric_manifest_shape.
9 docs evidence is in the preceding operator-attested comment with exact release-notes, user-guide, and jira-sync-setup citations.

Gerrit 1554 had LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, zero unresolved comments, and merged. The completion verifier already returned PASS for all nine criteria at this exact merged SHA before this close retry. This compact map is added because the subsequent close-gate run exhausted a 36-request high-breadth evidence search (56/57 distinct tool calls) without producing any criterion verdict; it supplies direct artifacts so the bounded successor need not rediscover them.
